  SELECT Stadium_ID, Year, COUNT(concert_ID) AS concert_count
  FROM concert
  GROUP BY Stadium_ID, Year
),
peak_years AS (

         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Stadium_ID ORDER BY concert_count DESC) AS rn

)

WHERE p.rn = 1
ORDER BY s.Name

It first calculates the number of concerts per year for each stadium, then ranks these years by concert count within each stadium. The final result selects the year with the highest concert count for each venue by joining the 'stadium' table with the computed peak years.
